Lease financing receivables, past due 30 through 89 days and still accruing. The total (consolidated RCFD1226, filed by the 031 from 2001; RCON1226 for the 041/051), else the 031 split leases to individuals + all other leases.

Lease financing receivables, nonaccrual. The total (consolidated RCFD1228, filed by the 031 from 2001; RCON1228 for the 041/051), else the 031 split leases to individuals (F168) + all other leases (F171). In 2011-2016 the two populations are disjoint; where both were reported (2008) they agree for 95.6% of banks.

All other loans and leases, past due 30 through 89 days and still accruing: the RC-N memorandum itemisation summed across loans to depository institutions, loans to foreign governments, other loans and lease financing receivables. Two parallel code blocks (K091-K101/K269-K272 and K134-K136/K283-K288) carry this memorandum; both are summed because they are near-disjoint in practice -- of ~2,700 populated bank-quarters only 29 report in both, and where both are populated the values differ, so they are distinct itemisations rather than duplicate filings. Memo item only: already included in the loan totals above. Collected 2011Q1-2016Q2.
